programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: A young ballerina is torn between two creative but possessive men: one a struggling composer, the other an autocratic impresario. Forced to choose between her career and a happy marriage, she is persuaded to do one last performance of the role that made her famous, with tragic results.

programme.title: The Elephant Man
programme.desc: Based on the life of John Merrick, a man born with a disfiguring disease who seemed doomed to a grim existence as a sideshow freak until taken in by a London surgeon and introduced to society. Despite his dreadful experiences, Merrick is a gentle, intelligent soul and becomes a popular guest in Victorian drawing rooms - but only if his deformed features are completely covered.

programme.title: The Stuarts in Exile
programme.desc: In this second episode, Dr Clare Jackson reveals why so many law-abiding Scots and English were prepared to support the Catholic Stuarts and how the new Protestant Hanoverian regime hung by a thread, as George I and II struggled to impose their authority on frequently hostile and anti-European subjects.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae hi'n fore o haf ond mae Tib yn deffro'n ysu am gael sledio, ond mae wedi siomi pan mae'n darganfod ei fod wedi breuddwydio'r eira! Tib wakes one summer morning wanting to go sledging.

programme.title: Sam Tân

programme.title: Jen a Jim a'r Cywiadur
programme.desc: Mae lleidr wedi cyrraedd y fferm, ond yr unig beth mae'n ei ddwyn yw letys. There's a thief on the farm, but the only thing stolen is a lettuce.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: Skunk smelt as sweet as sweet can be. In fact, whenever any animal had a smelly problem they went straight to Skunk. However, naughty Baboon tricks Skunk into tasting the yucky Smellyfruit.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.sub-title: Pam Bod Tywod ar Lan y Mor?
programme.desc: Mae Ela eisiau gwybod 'Pam bod tywod ar lan y môr? ac mae Tad-cu'n ymateb drwy rannu stori am sut mae morgrug ar draws y byd yn mynd i'r traeth. Ela asks: why is there sand by the seaside.

programme.title: Mari, Hari a'r Byd Tanddwr
programme.desc: Ymunwn â Mari a Hari wrth iddyn nhw ddarganfod amrywiaeth o gymeriadau doniol a diddorol sy'n byw o dan y môr. Join Mari and Hari as they meet fascinating characters who live under the sea.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ac mae'n angyfforddus ar ei fatres newydd. Mae'r fatres fel petai'n hedfan! Pablo's new matress feels a bit odd - almost as if it is flying!

programme.title: Misho
programme.desc: Y teimlad o fod ofn sydd dan sylw yn Misho heddiw ac mae Sali Simsan yn ei gwneud hi'n anodd iawn i blentyn bach fynd am dro ar y beic. Today Sali Simsan makes a bike ride very difficult.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Tro hwn, mae Lloyd yn ymweld â chlwb sglefrfyrddio arbennig yn Abertawe, ac fe gawn ni ddysgu beth yw murlun. Lloyd visits a skateboarding club in Swansea and we learn what a mural is.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Tref yn cael trafferth gyda'r peiriant golchi ac mae llanast yn y golchdy! Tref is having trouble with the washing machine and there is a mess in the laundry!

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Y tro hwn, y Mochyn dafadennog a'r Sebra sy'n cael y sylw. Come with us on a journey around the world to meet some animals. In this programme, we get to know the Warthog and the Zebra.

programme.title: Stiw
programme.desc: Mae Stiw'n gwneud cerdyn arbennig i roi i'r teulu i gyd ar Ddydd Santes Dwynwen. Stiw makes a very special card to give the family on St Dwynwen's Day to show how much he loves them all.

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori
programme.desc: O diar, mae Huwcyn Hwyaden wedi colli ei lais. Tybed i ble'r aeth e? Oh dear, Huwcyn Hwyaden has lost his voice. I wonder where it went?

programme.desc: Mae Siôn yn paratoi salad Eidalaidd ond yna mae diflaniad mochyn Magi'n denu ei sylw. Siôn gets ingredients together for a classic Italian salad, but is distracted when Magi's pig escapes.

Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Mark Addy

Drama, starring Sean Bean
